symptomShortText: Bracket housing pocket depth varying unit to unit

causesIshikawa.description: EMP-9310, Shift C - suspected of loading the previous revision of the NC program at shift start; no MES record of a program change was found
EQ-MILL14-001 automatic tool changer repeatability measured 0.9mm against a 0.2mm specification; drift confirmed on three separate test cycles
DOC-11890 Rev C - milling sequence unchanged, single released revision in the system
Casting lot CST-8120 dimensional cert PASS
Depth gauge GA-0730, last cal 2026-06-30, R&R 4.1%

fiveWhyChain.question: Why does pocket depth vary across units?
fiveWhyChain.answer: Depth measured 12.84mm against a 12.95-13.05mm window with a 0.62mm spread against a 0.10mm maximum

fiveWhyChain.question: Why was the depth wrong and inconsistent? (root cause)
fiveWhyChain.answer: The operator is believed to have loaded a superseded NC program at shift start

actions.actionText: Quarantine batch B-54390 and gauge pocket depth on 100% of X240 stock
Retrain Shift C operators on NC program selection and re-issue the setup sheet
Lock NC program selection to the released revision at the machine controller

fmeaLink.description: Incorrect program revision loaded at setup

lessonsLearned.whatWorked: The defect was contained within two days of detection
lessonsLearned.whatDidnt: The investigation closed on the operator explanation before the tool changer data was reviewed

isIsNot.isWhereWhenItHappens: X240 pockets milled on WC-MILL-07 across all three shifts from 2026-07-17
isIsNot.isNotWhereWhenItDoesnt: X240 milled on WC-MILL-09 - same program revision, same castings, same operators rotating through
isIsNot.notes: Defect appears on every shift at WC-MILL-07, not only on Shift C

customerReference.complaintReference: N/A - internal defect, no customer reference
